newsitem.title: UK: Aegon and AMP among favourites to buy Scot Am-S&P.
newsitem.headline: Aegon and AMP among favourites to buy Scot Am-S&P.

text.p: The Dutch insurance group Aegon and Australian Mutual Provident (AMP) are among the favourites to buy UK life insurance mutual Scottish Amicable, the UK life insurance expert at ratings agency Standard & Poor's told Reuters on Tuesday.

Martin Lees, S&P's specialist on the UK life market, said AMP had already stated its interest in more acquisitions in the UK, and that a company which uses independent financial advisors as its main means of distribution would be a good fit.
AMP, which is itself going through the demutualisation process, already owns UK life insurer Pearl but is said by industry sources to be less than satisfied with its performance.
